title: Ammonium Picratum
text: This remedy is indicated in cases of nervous disorders and fevers. It is useful in cases of malarial conditions and neuralgic pains. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of headaches and mental fatigue. Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo. Neuralgic pains in the head. Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness in the stomach. Frequent desire to urinate. Scanty urine. Compare: Picric acid; China; Arsenicum album. Third to sixth trituration.
